brief: Delta: no new setups, 5 of 5 slots are open (LINK, BTC, SOL triggered; CRV, DOGE watching). BTC OI fell 5.39% over 24h at funding 10.95, so the bounce reads as de-risking, not new demand. Tripwire hits XPL and BNB passed on full slots and L1/L2. XMR (funding 114, 65.4 over CEX) is the largest imbalance and L2 applies. Data gap: hl-cycles stale 20.9 h.
